job.title: UX/UI Designer – EdTech (Service Company)
job.description: EduMatrix Solutions is a Hyderabad IT services firm delivering EdTech platforms for university clients. We are hiring a UX/UI Designer to work on student portals, LMS dashboards, and faculty-facing admin tools. You will gather requirements from client stakeholders, produce wireframes and prototypes, and ensure timely delivery in Agile sprints. Experience with both B2C (student-facing) and B2B (admin) UX is preferred. Candidates with prior IT-services or consulting experience will be prioritised.
